Note: This is just my brief overview. @5DN1L might come after to give a more detailed review, and fix any (if there is) errors in my overview.

Thank you, @Naglfae, for your brief review! I agree mostly with all your points. Here are a few additional points.

Goal
* Please remove "... and look closely at what appears". If you prefer, you could rephrase it as an optional activity.

Game modes
* It's almost impossible to infer the task from the visible cases in Reverse mode. Consider disabling this mode.

Output
* <<[[n]] lines>> should be <<[[N]] lines>> instead.

* Please also format "i" as a [[variable]].

Cases
* Test 3 is identical to Test 7, and Validator 3 is identical to Validator 7. Please remove the duplicate pair.

* Please reorder all case pairs except the first pair, so that they're generally in ascending order of [[N]].

Thanks.
